# AI-assisted delegated scientific-review decision: E1 CLEAR, bounded E2/E3 descriptive CLEAR
**Reviewer role:** ChatGPT, AI-assisted delegated evidence reviewer under merged T02/T07 v1.2. **Date:** 2026-11-11 (America/New_York). **Researcher authority:** `docs/oversight/2026-11-10_RESEARCHER_EXPERIMENT_AUTHORIZATION.md`, 2026-11-10, approved E1-E4 eligible subset. This PR comment is an actual delegated reviewer decision; Codex must not present its own preparatory flags as the reviewer.

**Scope binding:** PR #11 code/evidence head `32e0928cf8cf085cd09ad1598ad7923af9ebcbd9`, frozen evidence `docs/week2/review-freeze.json` SHA `c90d063f7f17c9f929af2fddb4e3fe9bc719c9a4cae5c36f66b238f968e47c2e`, program `config/week2/program.proposed.json` file SHA `6f8d36a86eb6632b93ec61a5b7c14e2e7b5253bdd68ea62fa398753d485f4cb8`, source review SHA `1201f720fd312a6f359674f3d50a5494a56bf98df661a2eff402304b9f742655`, reference proposal file SHA `627fb59b5e8b6a0b307447d2e22355fc75449bb02c21c3063468004948928349`. The researcher authorized no paid services, no additional unreviewed data and no public release. Exact frozen original source bytes must be verified at runtime; any changed input/reference/panel/version requires a new prospective evidence decision rather than auto-admission.

## E1: CLEAR_FOR_E1

Seven new sources; `J01749.1` is a previously scored historical pBR322 control and must not be counted as a novel independent observation. E1 source feature preservation, location/strand, qualifiers, CDS agreement and abstentions may now execute and produce real outputs. Reviewed evidence includes exact source URLs/version/date/bytes, source notice search (no conflicts noted), QA preservation/translation checks, benign reporter/cloning context and local-compute use consistent with NCBI's molecular-data usage policy (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/). Provider IP caveat remains, so raw input, annotation sidecars and proteins stay in private/ignored storage, with source-free reports only in Git. Duplicate gene/protein lineages remain separate for source-preservation and are **not** independent family queries. All feature denominators must follow original T07 protocol, not bookkeeping counts.

## E2: CLEAR_FOR_E2_SUPPORTED_SUBSET_DESCRIPTIVE
**APPROVE as a small exploratory/descriptive run, not a full documented-family benchmark:** `AF298787.1` source-bound URA3 (`AAG34528.1`, OMP-decarboxylase homologs) and EGFP3 (`AAG34529.1`, GFP-like homologs) against the frozen 17-identity catalogue with exact-positive/ancestor/parent/vector-lineage exclusions from `data/manifests/week2/references/exclusion_evidence.json`, identical common panel and parent-level K=5 budget. Use pinned ESM-2 only as proposed in `config/week2/E2.proposed.json`. **AmpR remains unsupported and included in the full documented-family coverage denominator.** Disclose that literal longest source CDS is AmpR (286 aa) whereas longest currently supported eligible CDS is URA3 (267 aa). Never claim full-family recall or population-level performance from one parent. Recheck source/reference frozen hashes and exclude all other sources from E2 until separately cleared.

## E3: CLEAR_FOR_E3_TIER1_DESCRIPTIVE_ALIGNMENT_ESM2
**APPROVE a bounded exploratory E3 tier-1 comparison for only four exact query IDs**, using the frozen seventeen reviewed UniProt proteins and conservative exact-copy, same-parent, ancestor and vector/lineage exclusions with the same query/reference set for both methods:
- `ncbi-U47295.2/ncbi-U47295.2-u-b2052ad5b0d017c1f14c` (coleopteran luciferase homologs)
- `ncbi-U55762.1/ncbi-U55762.1-u-19863cb9a9722e562f34` (GFP-like homologs)
- `ncbi-AF298787.1/ncbi-AF298787.1-u-036e9d3cdc9d09cdb207` (OMP-decarboxylase homologs)
- `ncbi-AF298787.1/ncbi-AF298787.1-u-eb7f4497fb14c5bda714` (GFP-like homologs)

The relevant four family assignments and the 3/4/6-reference positive groups in the frozen proposal are accepted for this narrow molecular-homology retrieval exercise, not functional validation. Query sources `U47295.2`, `U55762.1`, `AF298787.1` admitted for this scoped local research. Approved methods: BLOSUM62 documented local alignment and the exact pinned ESM-2 8M checkpoint. Public ESM-2 model card lists MIT license (https://huggingface.co/facebook/esm2_t6_8M_UR50D). Retain same K=5, frozen embedding/score method and precision. Four CDS queries from **at most three independent parents** prohibit the predeclared eight-cluster confidence interval. Report descriptive metrics and null unsupported inference, not a conclusion that a model wins. Tier2 and Tier3 are HOLD pending separate reviewed evidence; no substitute threshold after results.

**HOLD ESM-C method for scored retrieval** because the archived checkpoint model card reports both `mit` and `other` with only a third-party dependency notice link, and the current packet expressly states that model-weight use-rights evidence is incomplete. Its technical fixture is valid, but does not clear source/model usage. Do not delay approved alignment and ESM-2 results to resolve ESM-C. Any E3 run using only cleared methods must be explicitly labeled `E3 descriptive partial-method pilot`, not the full three-method E3 benchmark.

**HOLD** AY864931 Renilla-family query (no independent positive); all nine iGEM candidate sequences for any source-only E1 or protein scoring outside the exact reviewed eight, the four other source-context HOLDs and the supplemental MK448012.1 fusion for this scored proposal. Candidate selection, anonymous downloads and source formatting checks do not grant admission.

## E4 and execution
**E4 formal scientific clearance = HOLD until actual compatible E2/E3 biological quality and measured cost records exist.** Codex may collect stage runtime/cost/memory and prepare exploratory descriptive bookkeeping immediately as part of cleared E2/E3; do not relabel fixture timings as E4 or promote unsupported plots. Once compatible real outcomes are available, bring only the resulting concise E4 evidence to this delegated review, not a repeat of source selection.

**Execution instructions:** This decision is sufficient for Codex to implement minimal versioned execution manifests and run the cleared E1 and bounded E2/E3 without asking the researcher or ChatGPT for another routine signoff. Keep source/original model/reference hashes and actual evidence preflight, hard resource bounds (existing CPU, <=6 GiB process RSS, <=1,800 seconds per model/stage, <=64 proteins and <=65,536 processed residues per stage, no scoring-time model download, no spending), versioned stage results and source-free Git output. If an unchanged, approved exact source cannot be restored/verified, HOLD that specific record and run other cleared cases. This clearance does not waive any mandatory reproducibility or safety gate and is not permission to alter the frozen design or publish biological source bytes. Cite **this PR comment** in the execution decision record and its source/method manifests. Single-agent incremental work; prioritize real E1, then alignment/ESM-2 E3, E2, and cost bookkeeping, before refactoring and log/test cleanup.
